rules.statement: The court has the inherent power under Section 839 of the Civil Procedure Code to set aside a probate order if procedural errors are made, especially when these errors could lead to fraud or abuse of process.
rules.supporting_quote: "In an appropriate case, depending on the circumstances, a court has jurisdiction to act under Section 839 of the Civil Procedure Code and make an order as may be necessary for the ends of justice or to prevent abuse of the process of the Court."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 839 of the Civil Procedure Code
